description:
Damage state for a mech between combats.

Tracks current resource levels and destroyed components.
Default values represent a fully healthy mech (full HP, structure, stress,
no destroyed components).

destroyed_weapons.description: Weapon IDs that are destroyed and need repair
destroyed_weapons.title: Destroyed Weapons

destroyed_systems.description: System IDs that are destroyed and need repair
destroyed_systems.title: Destroyed Systems

is_destroyed.description: Whether the mech is completely destroyed (wreck)
is_destroyed.title: Is Destroyed

title: MechDamageState
